column1: # Vietnamese words and their spelling in chữ Hán-Nôm, for the vi-Hani interface catalogue.
# scripts/build_vi_hani.py writes apps/review/src/locales/vi-Hani.json from vi.json by replacing
# each word, longest match first, with its spelling here. A word missing from this table stops the
# build; `--propose` suggests spellings for it from the sources below.
#   wiktionary  the English Wiktionary Vietnamese entries (CC BY-SA 4.0), through the kaikki.org
#               form of the word, a character glossed "chữ Nôm form of" it, or, for a Sino-Vietnamese
#               word, the Han etymon its etymology names (note "etymology").
#   unihan      the kVietnamese reading in Unihan 18.0.0 (Unicode, 2026-07-31).
#   joined      a compound joined here from syllables each attested in one of those two; the whole
#               word is not attested in that spelling.
#   editorial   chosen here without one of those sources: Sino-Vietnamese words written with their
#               Han etymon, and the script names.
# Where the sources attest several spellings of a word, the choice among them is editorial: the one
# for the sense the interface means (trong 𥪝 "in", theo 蹺 "along"), else the most attested.
# The spellings are an editorial reconstruction of how modern interface wording would be written in
# chữ Nôm; no Nôm text attests most of these phrases, and no native reader has reviewed them yet.
